description: [PAID $0.008 USDC/call, x402, eip155:8453] Fetch any public page and return clean readable text (title, meta description, body text up to 20 000 characters) plus the origin status and the method actually used. If the page answers 403/429/503 or returns an empty JavaScript shell, the service retries through a browser engine before answering.

url.description: Full http(s) URL of the public page
